title: When you paste a screenshot into a thread, where is the image kept?
context: Matt wants to paste or drop screenshots into hub threads, and copy screenshots agents post. The images have to be stored somewhere, and agents must receive them as real images. Builds on decision 2 (append-only event log).

options.name: Files next to the project's event log
options.summary: Images are saved under the project's .crux/attachments/; the message event points to the file. Agents receive the image itself. Screenshots agents post can share the same store.
pros: .crux/ is already kept out of git
cons: The folder grows; needs an occasional tidy

options.name: Inline in the event log
options.summary: Images are stored as data inside the message events.
cons: The append-only log keeps every image forever, growing heavy and slow to replay

options.name: In the home folder, outside every project
pros: Confidential screenshots never sit in a project folder
cons: The project's history depends on files kept elsewhere

recommendation: Keeps the log lean and the project self-contained, and .crux/ is already out of git.

settles.value: files under the project's .crux/attachments/, referenced by id from message events; never inline in the event log
